name: Acbric LWJGL3 Engine
description: Ships the Slick2D/LWJGL2 -> LWJGL3 engine migration for Airships: Conquer the Skies as an Acbric mod. Its jar shadows the vanilla game, Slick2D and LWJGL2 classes with the migrated LWJGL3 implementations. / 把《Airships: Conquer the Skies》的 Slick2D/LWJGL2 到 LWJGL3 引擎迁移版作为 Acbric MOD 交付：jar 内的类压过原版游戏、Slick2D 与 LWJGL2 的同名类。
